eject.title: Eject
eject.body: Remove from the wheel and shuffle into the Dungeon Deck

bear_trap.title: Bear Trap
bear_trap.body: A 2 HP 3 ATK monster that Attacks you when you Move or Spin onto it.

move.title: Move
move.body: Shift to a Neighbor without Spinning

marked.title: Marked
marked.body: Upon Defeat, Trapper gains +2 HP and ATK

poison.title: Poison
poison.body: Monsters with Poison lose that much HP when you Spin them, then lose all Poison.

spin.title: Spin
spin.body: The wheel lands on a monster.

swap.title: Swap
swap.body: Trade it for a random item of the same rarity.

loaded.title: Loaded
loaded.body: Your next Attack can hit any monster.

rust.title: Rust
rust.body:
(Item) - On Use, Gain 2 Block and Lose 1 HP. 
Passive: Whenever you Gain Block, Gain 1 Rust.

decay.title: Decay
decay.body: If you Use this, Keep it and Discard all other Items with Decay.

gaze.title: Gaze
gaze.body: Marks up to three Items. Using one Petrifies the others while the Basilisk remains.

curse.title: Curse
curse.body: Negative Item; Cannot be willingly discarded.

shroud.title: Shroud
shroud.body: Hidden until Defeated, or until you resolve combat while facing them.

toll.title: Toll
toll.body: Unplayable. −1 on each Item Use. At 0, you Die.

hex.title: Hex
hex.body: Unplayable. −1 each Spin. At 0, Defeat the landed enemy.

beggar.title: Beggar
beggar.body: Marks a random Item. Spinning this Beggar discards it.

keep.title: Keep
keep.body: Stays in your hand when used (Usable once per Spin)
